The 16th edition of the Festival of Freedom. The festival’s events reflect the reality of undemocratic regimes and are aimed at a wide audience. The programme comprises a film screening, theatre performances, an expert seminar, discussions, exhibitions, a concert, open days at the ÚPN Archive and other accompanying events. The full programme is available on [the website](https://www.festivalslobody.sk/). Free admission, wheelchair accessible, suitable for the deaf.
